comparison.objective: Use two-handed hedge shears to cut three shoots while sparing nearby flowers.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual articulated-tool positioning and closing around selected stems.
comparison.success_condition: All three shoots severed near target height, no flower cut, shears returned closed, arms returned, stable for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Both deliberately separate material, but hedge trimming tests selective scissor cutting of exposed stems; it does not test recessed coaxial access, impact fracture at a notch, insert retention, or fragment recovery.
